title: Janaza Zehra ka Uth Raha Hai
body:
Ali Ki Aankhon Mein Khoon Bhara Hai
Janaza Zahra Ka Uth Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Nabi Ke Roze Ko Zalzala Hai

<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Kaisa Ummat Ne Zulm Dhaaya
Nabi Ki Beti Ka Ghar Jalaaya
Shikasta Pehlu Bhi Ho Chuka Hai

<<DIVIDER>>
Ali Ke Bachchon Ka Qad Hai Chhota
Woh Dein Janaze Ko Kaise Kandha

<<DIVIDER>>
Hayaat Athaarah Saal Ki Thi
Abhi Se Baalon Mein Ye Safedi

<<DIVIDER>>
Hasan Ka Tukde Hua Kaleja

<<DIVIDER>>
Rasool-e-Haq Ki Jo Thi Amaanat

Janaza Zahra Ka Uth Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Hashr Hai Bait-e-Mustafa Mein
Bapa Hai Kohraam Ambiya Mein
Fiza Mein Jibreel Ki Sada Hai

<<DIVIDER>>
Karenge Hasnain Kyun Na Giriya
Nahi Hai Ab Sar Pe Maa Ka Saaya
Gharana Haider Ka Ghamzada Hai
Janaza Zahra Ka Uth Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Arab Ki Malika Ki Jo Thi Beti
Kya Hai Ummat Ne Usko Zakhmi
Nabi Ka Tukda Jigar Hua Hai
Janaza Zahra Ka Uth Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bapa Ho Masoom Kyun Na Matam
Ho Chashm-e-Mashhad Na Kis Tarah Nam
Ye Ek Jumla Bahut Bada Hai
Janaza Zahra Ka Uth Raha Hai
author: Masoom Maroofi
